name: Crispy Tofu Bites
ingredients: 250 g extra-firm tofu, pressed and cut in bite-size cubes
½ tsp each garlic powder, paprika and cumin
Lemon wedges and mint chutney, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper.
Toss the tofu with the oil, cornflour, besan, spices and salt until evenly coated.
Spread in a single layer and bake for 25 minutes, turning at 15 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with lemon and chutney.
note: A baked, low-oil snack or protein topper for bowls.
